name: Positive User
summary: Marketing automation platform from the French Positive group, formerly User.com: email, SMS and WhatsApp campaigns, real-time visitor tracking, website personalisation and workflows, hosted in Europe.
best_for: European small and mid-sized businesses that want email, SMS, WhatsApp and website behaviour tracking in one EU-hosted platform, with a modest sending volume and a small marketing team
skip_if: you send large newsletters every week, you want month-to-month billing printed up front, or you only need a newsletter tool and not the automation and tracking layer
honest_knock: Every Marketing Suite plan stops at 60,000 emails a year, about 5,000 a month, and the next step up is the Performance plan at €999 a month with 300,000 emails a month (pricing page, 13 November 2026), so a weekly newsletter to a few thousand contacts outgrows even the €499 plan. The page prints only annual prices, seats beyond the included one or two cost €69 to €199 a month each, and auto-renewal is on by default: stopping an annual plan takes notice to your account manager at least 30 days ahead, with no refund for the rest of the term. The 7-day trial is short for an automation platform. We have not used Positive User ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Campaigns · per month billed annually, 1 seat included
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-07 on user.com/pricing in a browser render, prices in EUR as the page prints them, billed annually; re-verified 2026-11-13 with a plain fetch) Positive User, the platform formerly called User.com and now part of the French Positive group, sells a Marketing Suite in three plans. Campaigns is €69 a month billed annually with 1 seat: email, SMS and WhatsApp marketing, the drag-and-drop editor, a library of ready-made workflows, unlimited contacts, up to 60,000 emails a year, up to 6,000 WhatsApp messages a year and 5 active workflows. Marketing Automation Suite is €199 a month with 2 seats and adds real-time visitor tracking, website personalisation, pop-ups, event tracking, a 360-degree contact view, advanced segmentation and AI agents, with 24,000 WhatsApp messages a year, 20 active workflows, 50 forms and 50 landing pages. Customer Engagement Platform is €499 a month with 2 seats and adds product recommendations, web push and the advanced data platform, with up to 120,000 WhatsApp messages a year, 100 workflows, 100 forms and 100 landing pages. Every plan includes up to 60,000 emails a year. Extra seats cost €69, €99 or €199 a seat a month billed annually, depending on the plan. Add-ons: Loyalty Program €199 a month, Sales €59, Customer Service €59 and Mobile App Marketing €59, all billed annually; on Campaigns, forms and landing pages were €29 a month each on 7 October (€49 each on 13 November). A separate Data & Activation Suite for teams of 10 or more users was not priced on the page on 7 October. The FAQ says monthly billing exists, but the page prints only annual prices; the free trial lasts 7 days with no card, auto-renewal is on by default, and cancelling stops the renewal without a refund. Re-read on 13 November 2026: the three Marketing Suite prices, included seats and extra-seat prices are unchanged. The page now gives the allowances per month, 5,000 emails on every Marketing Suite plan and 500, 2,000 or 10,000 WhatsApp messages, the same totals as the yearly figures above. Three things changed. Forms and landing pages on Campaigns now cost €49 a month each, and the Marketing Automation Suite lists a Website Experience add-on at €59 a month. The Data & Activation Suite now has a published plan: Performance at €999 a month billed annually with 10 seats (extra seats €199 a seat a month), up to 300,000 emails a month, up to 100,000 marketing contacts and 10,000 WhatsApp messages a month; Limitless, with unlimited seats and sending, is priced through sales. The same page also sells a Newsletter Suite of rapidmail plans: Essential €15 and Professional €25 a month, or €20 for a single pay-as-you-go send. The FAQ now says add-ons are billed per seat, and that switching off auto-renewal on a Data & Activation plan takes 90 days' notice before the annual renewal date.

compare_with.name: Brevo
compare_with.why: Brevo is in our dossiers too and also combines email, SMS and WhatsApp for small businesses. Positive User puts the weight on behaviour: real-time visitor tracking, personalisation and workflows from the €199 plan, with unlimited contacts but a fixed 60,000 emails a year on every Marketing Suite plan. A team whose cost driver is sending volume should price both on its real yearly email count before choosing.
